selection_policy.identity_rule: Official identifier evidence first; full-title web search is candidate retrieval only and numeric or topical similarity is never identity evidence.
selection_policy.order: All eight newly verified Nature and Science TeX candidates in the frozen second-pass audit, then all 47 direct-author PRL candidates and all four exact-DOI PRL collaboration-author records in the frozen PRL audit.
selection_policy.sampling_interpretation: Operational expansion cohort, not a complete Nature/Science census and not an unbiased conversion-rate sample.
